title: Torcy to the plenipotentiaries at Geertruidenberg, Versailles, 3 Apr 1710, BL Add MS 61575 ff. 38-41

steps.what: Sought the ciphertext: Tomokiyo's files 404, DECODE images need login (thumbnail only), BL volume not digitised.
Fetched with the cookie the DECODE images of R8755 (7), its DOC transcription (Tomokiyo's, the file his dead link pointed to), and the neighbour records R8746-R8774.
Checked the DOC transcription against the images: it agrees (notation 11^0=110 etc.; 729 confirmed by a repeat). Transcribed the clear opening of the letter (f.38r-38v), which DECODE omits.
Prior-solution check: Tomokiyo's blencowe2.htm unchanged (undeciphered), web search found no edition or decipherment.
Applied Tomokiyo's 11B table (Desmarets 4 June 1710 code, ~190 values): nonsense.
Checked the Add MS 61575 keys: R8766 (Torcy-Petkum, DE=43/140; the letter has 43 once, 140 never), R8767 (one-part, DE=215 absent, English names).
Applied DECODE R587 (TNA SP 106/7 French two-part code, DECODE transcription) to Torcy: word salad of Northern names.
Screened BnF fr. 6204 War-ministry keys and the 1702 Usson code by their DE homophones (Tomokiyo); the Sixième clef is excluded by 'de de' (423 411) twice; the rest have 0-7 hits.
Legrelle iv 546 quotes the clear sentence and cites the letter in AE CP Hollande t. 223; Torcy's Journal inédit (30 Mar-3 Apr 1710) gives the context only.
690 groups, 285 types, IC 0.0042, two repeated trigrams: an 800+ value homophonic two-part code, too sparse for a ciphertext-only rebuild.
Split under the one-key rule: Villars to Polignac, 1 Jun 1710 (R8756), a different code, moved to villars1710 with its transcription; this entry keeps Torcy's letter (R8755).

outcome.method_basis: The cipher part is unread: no key in Add MS 61575, on DECODE or in print fits; 690 groups of an 800+ value two-part code are too few for a ciphertext-only rebuild. The French copy of the letter is in AE CP Hollande t. 223, not online.

gaps.detail: no key found; French copy in AE CP Hollande t. 223, not digitised

outcome.notes: Clear opening of the letter transcribed (DECODE omits it). Villars' letter of 1 June 1710 (R8756), a different code, was split off on 14 Oct 2026 to villars1710.

credits.note: DECODE transcription of R8755, checked against the images

prior.where: The French file copy of Torcy's letter, AE CP Hollande t. 223 (cited by Legrelle iv 546 n.2); nothing printed; Tomokiyo (blencowe2.htm, 2024) lists both as undeciphered

human: Selected the target; supplied the DECODE login cookie.
